validation_notes: The right side of the chart (Jun-Aug) shows a consistent downtrend into a tight consolidation range around 1.0-1.2, but there's no clear descending triangle structure. Price action from mid-June onward is largely flat/rangebound with roughly horizontal support (~1.03-1.05) and resistance (~1.15-1.20), which looks more like a shallow horizontal channel or basing pattern than a converging triangle. There's no clear series of lower highs compressing toward a flat support line - highs are fairly flat too, not descending. The overall trend from January is a strong downtrend with lower highs and lower lows throughout, but this is trend continuation, not a well-defined triangle apex forming at the right edge. I don't see the two converging trendlines with sufficient touch points required for a credible descending triangle call.
